titlePlain: Docker Networking and Volumes for a Local Multi-Container
subtitle: Lesson 4 · Docker for Platform Engineers

code:
docker network create app-net

docker run -d --name db --network app-net \
  -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=devpassword \
  postgres:16

docker run -d --name api --network app-net \
  -e DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:devpassword@db:5432/postgres \
  my-api:latest
caption: db resolves to the Postgres container's IP automatically — the default bridge can't do this.

eyebrow: Two ways to keep data outside the writable layer

steps.label: Bind mount
steps.sub: -v /host/src:/app/src — host path is the live source of truth

steps.label: Pick by ownership
steps.sub: container-owned data → volume; host-owned source → bind mount

code:
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: devpassword
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data

  api:
    build: ./api
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:devpassword@db:5432/postgres
    depends_on:
      - db
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"

volumes:
  pgdata:
caption: docker compose up creates the network, the volume, and service-name DNS automatically.
